name: task-planner
description: Creates a session plan artifact and waits for explicit approval before task execution.

interface.shortDescription: Plan first, then execute after explicit approval.
interface.longDescription: Writes a concrete, reviewable Markdown plan in the current session and pauses execution until the user explicitly approves that displayed revision.
defaultPrompt: Use $task-planner to create a concrete session plan and wait for my explicit approval before executing it.
